title: Crestline Fare Brands: Booking Conditions, Courtesy Holds, Risk-Free Void and Ticket Validity
content:
**Fare rules schedule — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** Every ticket is sold for one passenger under one of six fare brands. The brand fixes the cabin the passenger is booked in, whether the ticket may be booked under a corporate travel agreement or as an award ticket, and the time limits that run from booking and from ticket issue.

## Booking conditions by fare brand

| Fare brand | Cabin booked | Corporate booking | Award booking | Itinerary classes sold |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | Main cabin | Not permitted | Not permitted | Domestic, short-haul international, long-haul international |
| Crestline Main Cabin | Main cabin | Permitted | Permitted | Domestic, short-haul international, long-haul international |
| Crestline Main Plus | Main cabin | Permitted | Permitted | Domestic, short-haul international, long-haul international |
| Crestline Main Flexible | Main cabin | Permitted | Not permitted | Domestic, short-haul international, long-haul international |
| Crestline Premium Economy | Premium Economy cabin | Permitted | Permitted | Domestic, short-haul international, long-haul international |
| Crestline First | First cabin | Permitted | Permitted | Domestic, short-haul international, long-haul international |

These conditions must hold when the reservation is booked.

## Time limits by fare brand

| Fare brand | Courtesy hold (hours) | Risk-free void window after issue (elapsed hours) | Ticket validity (calendar months from issue) | Name correction limit (characters in total) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | 0 | 24 | 12 | 3 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 24 | 24 | 12 | 3 |
| Crestline Main Plus | 24 | 24 | 12 | 3 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | 24 | 24 | 12 | 3 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 24 | 24 | 12 | 3 |
| Crestline First | 24 | 24 | 12 | 3 |

**Reading the columns.**

- *Courtesy hold* is the number of hours a reservation may stay held unpaid before it lapses. A figure of 0 means no courtesy hold is offered and the fare must be ticketed at booking; Crestline Basic Economy is the only brand with 0.
- *Risk-free void window* is the number of elapsed hours after ticket issue during which the ticket may be voided for a full refund. It is 24 on every brand, Crestline Basic Economy included.
- *Ticket validity* is the number of calendar months from ticket issue during which travel on the ticket must begin: 12 on every brand.
- *Name correction limit* is the most characters of the passenger name, in total, that may be corrected without a recorded legal name change: 3 on every brand.

## Points of comparison

- Five of the six brands share the same four limits; Crestline Basic Economy differs only in having no courtesy hold.
- The void window and the validity period start from ticket issue, while the courtesy hold starts from booking.
